definitions.gloss: to politely decline; to turn down gracefully
definitions.explanation: To refuse an offer, invitation, or request in a respectful and considerate manner, showing regard for the other person's feelings.

examples.japanese: お⟦{誘|さそ}い→誘い：14200_sasoi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{丁重|ていちょう}に{断|ことわ}った。
⟦{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}→申し訳：03810_moushiwake⟧なさそう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{丁重|ていちょう}に{断|ことわ}られた。
examples.english: I was turned down gracefully, with an apologetic manner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{取引先|とりひきさき}→取引先：11083_torihikisaki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{提案|ていあん}→提案：03536_teian⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べて→述べる：02389_noberu⟧{丁重|ていちょう}に{断|ことわ}ること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important to politely decline a proposal from a business partner by stating your reasons.

notes:
A set phrase combining ⟦{丁重|ていちょう}→丁重：15777_teichou⟧ (polite, courteous) with ⟦{断|ことわ}る→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧ (to refuse). This is the standard way to describe refusing something while maintaining politeness and respect. Essential in Japanese business and social contexts where outright refusal is considered rude.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お⟦{申|もう}し{出|で}→申し出：13560_moushide⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{丁重|ていちょう}に{断|ことわ}る — to politely decline an offer
- ⟦{丁重|ていちょう}→丁重：15777_teichou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{断|ことわ}り→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to politely refuse (humble form)
- ⟦{依頼|いらい}→依頼：02594_irai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{丁重|ていちょう}に{断|ことわ}る — to politely decline a request

SIMILAR WORDS:
- やんわり⟦{断|ことわ}る→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧ — to refuse softly/gently; less formal than ⟦{丁重|ていちょう}→丁重：15777_teichou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧
- ⟦きっぱり→きっぱり：06354_kippari⟧⟦{断|ことわ}る→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧ — to refuse firmly/decisively; the opposite approach
- ⟦{遠慮|えんりょ}する→遠慮する：19518_enryosuru⟧ — to decline; more indirect and softer

REGISTER:
Appropriate for formal and business situations. In casual contexts, やんわり⟦{断|ことわ}る→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧ is more natural.
